# INTERNATIONAL COPPER STUDY GROUP 

# **CNDR 10/01 20 January 2010 English Only** 

# **Note to the Designated Representatives of Member Countries ICSG 18**<sup>**th**</sup> **SESSION** 

# **LISBON – APRIL 2010** 

Please find hereunder the provisional programme of meetings of the18th General Session of the International Copper Study Group that will take place in Lisbon, Portugal on 29 and 30 April, with a Joint Study Groups’ Seminar “New & Innovative Applications for Metals” to be held on 28 April. 

## **Wednesday 28 April 2010** 

2.00pm-5.30pm Joint Study Groups’ Seminar “New & Innovative Applications for Metals” 

## **Thursday 29 April 2010** 

9.00am-12.00noon ICSG Environmental & Economic Committee 

2.00pm-3.30pm ICSG Statistical Committee Forecasting Session 4.00pm-5.00pm ICSG Industry Advisory Panel Evening ICSG Reception 

## **Friday 30 April 2010** 

9.00am-12.00noon ICSG Statistical Committee (cont.) 

1.30pm-2.30pm ICSG Finance Committee (governments only) 2.30pm-3.30pm ICSG Standing Committee (governments only) 3.30pm-4.30pm ICSG Plenary Session 

## **Meetings of the other Study Groups** 

For your reference meetings of the other Study Groups will be held in Lisbon at that time as 

_________________________________________________________________________________ 

Rua Almirante Barroso, 38 - 6th floor, 1000-013 Lisbon, Portugal                  Tel: +351-21-351-3870 email: mail@icsg.org                                                                                        Fax:+351-21-352-4035 

## **Joint Study Groups’ Seminar** 

For the Joint Study Groups’ meeting in the afternoon of Wednesday 28 April it has been decided, following consultations with Chairmen and preliminary contact with possible participants, that the Groups will hold a joint seminar on the theme “New and Innovative Applications for Metals”.  The objective of the seminar will be to exchange views on the various new and innovative uses of non-ferrous metals, to understand how the relevant industry associations and their members are promoting these applications, to see what role member governments play in supporting efforts to develop and promote innovation, and to see what role the Study Groups might play. 

## **Venue** 

All meetings will be held at the ICSG Headquarters, Main Conference Room, Ground Floor, 38 Rua Almirante Barroso, Lisbon (closest Metro stations are Picoas and Saldanha) 

## **Delegations** 

Member countries are requested to inform the Study Group secretariat by 12 April 2010 of the names and details of all members of their delegations, including industry advisers, preferably using the attached Registration Form. 

Member countries are urged to include representatives of their countries’ copper producing and consuming industries in their delegations. 

## **Accommodation** 

A list of other hotels with prices will be forwarded separately in the near future. 

## **Visas** 

Delegates requiring visas for entry into Portugal are asked

to apply for their visas at their local Portuguese Consulate as soon as possible, and to provide the secretariat with the appropriate names, birth dates and passport numbers in order for the Portuguese authorities to provide instructions to their consulates.  If letters of invitation are required, please contact the secretariat. Please allow sufficient time for the authorities to process applications (at least three weeks). 

Please forward this document to your industry advisers and other representatives so that we can ensure strong representation at the meetings. 

We are looking forward to your participation.  Please contact the Secretariat (mail@icsg.org) if you have any queries at all. 

Best regards 

Don Smale Secretary-General, ICSG 

_________________________________________________________________________________ 

Rua Almirante Barroso, 38 - 6th floor, 1000-013 Lisbon, Portugal                  Tel: +351-21-351-3870 email: mail@icsg.org                                                                                        Fax:+351-21-352-4035
